dedupe_keys.name: infrastructure risk atlas of pakistan ndma

description: The Infrastructure Risk Atlas is the first atlas of its kind for Pakistan, published by the Infrastructure Advisory and Project Development wing of the National Disaster Management Authority, with a chairman's message dated December 2024. It maps, at district level, the risk to residential buildings from earthquakes and floods, based on the structural distribution of the building stock. The method, set out in the atlas, took district counts of houses from the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics, classified structures by roof and wall type with a version of the European Macroseismic Scale (EMS-98) adapted for Pakistan, assessed the vulnerability of each type, and overlaid hazard maps with vulnerability maps to produce risk maps. The 46-page atlas holds national earthquake and flood maps and provincial maps for Punjab, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Sindh and Balochistan. Access is free as a PDF on the NDMA site; no licence is stated in the pages read. Caveats: the atlas covers residential buildings only, results are aggregated to districts, and the underlying tables are not published separately. Coverage is Pakistan. It supports hazard exposure and vulnerability analysis of the building stock and the prioritisation of retrofitting; related records are the Mexico Atlas Nacional de Riesgos and InaRISK of Indonesia.
